assistente.algoDeuErrado: Something went wrong while talking to Ollama.
assistente.convite: Ask anything about what is on the screen — the statement, the working, why your answer did not match. What you are looking at goes along with the question.
assistente.placeholder: Ask about what is on the screen…
assistente.semContato: Could not reach Ollama at {url}. Is it running? And if this site is open over the internet, Ollama has to allow the origin: start it with OLLAMA_ORIGINS="*" ollama serve.
assistente.semConteudo: The server answered with no content.

atualizacao.descricaoDisponivel: The new files are downloaded and ready. Restarting takes a few seconds, and your progress is kept.
atualizacao.descricaoIrrecuperavel: The version you had open can no longer load in full — this happens when the site is republished while this tab is open. Reloading fixes it.
atualizacao.recarregar: This tab needs to be reloaded

calculadora.camposTrocados: Swapping the fields gives a whole-number pair: {a} and {b} have sum {soma} and product {produto}. In x² + bx + c, the sum is b, the number next to the x.
calculadora.explicacaoFatores: Two numbers with this sum and this product — the step that factors x² + bx + c, in the order the expression reads. The roots are their opposites.
calculadora.paresTentados: Pairs with that product, and what each one adds up to
calculadora.passaDoExato: The result goes past what can be computed exactly.
calculadora.pedidoFatores: Write the product and the sum.
calculadora.pedidoInteiros: Two or more whole numbers, separated by commas.
calculadora.semParInteiroLongo: No pair of integers has that product and that sum; the two numbers above are the exact pair.
calculadora.semParReal: There are no two real numbers with that product and that sum.
calculadora.semZero: Zero is left out: use whole numbers greater than zero.

circuloTrig.descricao: Unit circle with an angle of {graus} degrees in quadrant {quadrante}. Cosine {cosseno}, sine {seno}.

config.acertosExigentesAjuda: Stops a stage from being won on easy exercises alone.
config.acertosNaJanelaAjuda: How many of those exercises must be right.
config.acertosParaSubir: Correct in a row to level up
config.acertosPorTipoAjuda: Where a topic has distinct types — nine in Fractions — how many each one asks for.
config.acertosSeguidosFinais: Correct in a row at the end
config.acertosSeguidosFinaisAjuda: So a stage does not open right after a mistake. One mistake resets this count.
config.aviso: Nothing here erases your progress. Lowering a requirement may open a stage at once; raising it may close one.
config.errosParaDescer: Wrong in a row to level down
config.errosParaDescerAjuda: Pushing on at a level that does not hold yet teaches nothing.
config.errosToleradosAjuda: The mistake after this number resets the whole session.
config.explicacao.escada: The level is not chosen: it rises with answers right in a row and falls with wrong ones in a row.
config.explicacao.etapa: The criterion looks only at recent attempts, to measure what you know now.
config.explicacao.prova: At the end of each area there is an exam on everything it covered. Failing resets the whole area.
config.explicacao.topicos: Uncheck what you are not going to study. The topic leaves the trail, the sidebar and the area exam — your progress in it is kept, and comes back if you check it again.
config.introducao: These are the numbers that decide when a stage opens and what the final exam tolerates. Any change applies at once, to the progress you already have.
config.minimoDeQuestoesAjuda: The exam asks one question per type of each topic, and fills up to this minimum.
config.respostasNaJanelaAjuda: How many recent attempts are counted.
config.resumoEtapa: Today: get {acertos} of the last {respostas} exercises right, {exigentes} of them at Medium or Hard, ending with {seguidos} right in a row.
config.resumoProva: Today: the exam has at least {minimo} questions and tolerates {tolerados} mistakes — number {zera} resets the whole area.

corpoObs.barra pela ponta: The same rod turning about its end resists four times as much.
corpoObs.barra pelo centro: Here r is the full length, not the distance to the axis.
corpoObs.casca cilíndrica: A hoop, or a thin-walled tube: everything at the rim.
corpoObs.casca esférica: Same radius, all the mass on the surface — a larger factor than the solid sphere.
corpoObs.disco ou cilindro maciço: Half the mass sits near the axis, so the factor drops.
corpoObs.esfera maciça: The mass gathers even closer to the centre.
corpoObs.partícula: All the mass at distance r from the axis — the reference case.

algebra.descricao: Swapping numbers for letters to solve the general case at once.

calculo-1.descricao: Derivatives: the mathematics of what changes, instant by instant.

calculo-2.descricao: Integrals: adding infinitely many infinitely small parts.

calculo-3.descricao: Multivariable calculus: differentiating and integrating in more than one direction.

calculo-4.descricao: Differential equations: the rule by which quantities change.

estatistica.descricao: Counting possibilities and measuring uncertainty — no real measurement is exact. It is not an engineering prerequisite, which is why it closes the path.

fisica.descricao: Mathematics applied to the world: from the inclined plane to the rocket in orbit.

funcoes.descricao: The language engineering uses to describe one quantity depending on another.

geometria-analitica.descricao: Geometry solved with algebra, once the plane has coordinates.

geometria.descricao: Measuring space: angles, areas and volumes before moving to coordinates.

matematica-basica.descricao: The foundation: how numbers combine, compare and measure.

pre-calculo.descricao: The bridge: the idea of approximation, before the machinery of calculus — from intuitive to formal.

trigonometria.descricao: Angles become numbers — and that is how a trajectory is computed.

vetores-matrizes.descricao: Quantities with direction and tables of numbers: the toolkit of mechanics.

analise-combinatoria.descricao: The multiplication principle, arrangements, permutations and combinations.

analise-dimensional.descricao: The dimensions of quantities and how to check a formula without computing anything.

angulos-e-triangulos.descricao: Angle sum, congruence and the triangle inequality.

aplicacoes-da-derivada.descricao: Maxima and minima, optimization, related rates, L’Hôpital and the mean value theorem.

aplicacoes-da-integral.descricao: Area between curves, volume of solids of revolution and arc length.

aplicacoes-de-edo.descricao: Setting up the equation: cooling, decay, RL circuit and mixing.

areas-de-figuras-planas.descricao: Where each area formula comes from, and why the ratio of areas is k².

cinematica-escalar.descricao: Uniform and uniformly accelerated motion, motion graphs and the area under the velocity curve.

cinematica-vetorial.descricao: Position, velocity and acceleration as vectors, in two and three dimensions.

circulo-e-poligonos.descricao: Circumference, area of the circle, sectors and regular polygons.

circulo-trigonometrico.descricao: From the triangle to the circle of radius 1, radians and angles beyond 90°.

circunferencia.descricao: Standard and general equations, and how a line can meet a circle.

composicao-inversa.descricao: Chaining functions and reflecting the graph in the line y = x.

conceito-funcao.descricao: Domain, codomain, range and the vertical line test.

conicas.descricao: Ellipse, parabola and hyperbola as sections of a cone — and as orbits.

continuidade.descricao: Functions without jumps and the intermediate value theorem.

coordenadas-no-espaco.descricao: Changing systems so the symmetry drops out of the computation — and the Jacobian.

definicao-de-derivada.descricao: From secant to tangent: the limit of Newton’s quotient.

derivacao-implicita.descricao: Differentiating without solving for y, which is the way when the curve is not a function.

derivadas-exponencial-logaritmo.descricao: The function that is its own derivative, and the one that becomes 1/x.

derivadas-parciais.descricao: Differentiating one direction at a time, and what second order reveals.

derivadas-trigonometricas.descricao: Differentiating sine, cosine and tangent — and why the derivative of sine is cosine.

dinamica-rotacional.descricao: Moment of inertia, torque and the second law for rotation.

distribuicao-normal.descricao: The bell curve: mean, standard deviation and the 68-95-99 rule.

edo-primeira-ordem.descricao: Separating variables, integrating factor, transient and steady state.

edo-segunda-ordem.descricao: The characteristic equation and the three damping regimes.

equacao-primeiro-grau.descricao: Solving ax + b = 0 and seeing the root as where the line crosses the x-axis.

equacao-segundo-grau.descricao: The quadratic formula, the discriminant and the three possible root situations.

equacoes-parametricas.descricao: The curve described by time: x(t) and y(t), and the path they trace.

estatica-e-torque.descricao: Balance of forces and moments, centre of mass and stability.

estatistica-e-incerteza.descricao: Mean, standard deviation, line fitting and error propagation in a measurement.

expressoes-algebricas.descricao: Variables, like terms and evaluating expressions.

fatoracao.descricao: Common factor, grouping and perfect square trinomial.

fluidos-e-aerodinamica.descricao: Pressure, buoyancy, Bernoulli’s equation and where lift comes from.

fracoes.descricao: Parts of a whole, equivalence, simplifying and the four operations, in both forms: fraction and mixed number. Plus converting decimals — nine types in all, three correct answers for each before the stage opens.

funcao-afim.descricao: Slope and intercept, growth and the zero of the function.

funcao-exponencial.descricao: Multiplicative growth, the number e and half-life.

funcao-logaritmica.descricao: The logarithm as the inverse of the exponential, and its properties.

funcao-modular.descricao: Absolute value as distance and the effect of the corner on the graph.

funcao-quadratica.descricao: Parabola, vertex, concavity and maximum and minimum problems.

funcoes-de-varias-variaveis.descricao: Domain as a region, graph as a surface and level curves.

funcoes-por-partes.descricao: A different rule on each interval, and what happens at the joins.

funcoes-racionais.descricao: A quotient of polynomials: domain, asymptotes and what happens near where the denominator vanishes.

funcoes-trigonometricas.descricao: Amplitude, period and phase: the shape of the wave.

gradiente-e-direcional.descricao: The vector of steepest ascent, and the rate in any direction.

gravitacao-e-orbitas.descricao: The law of gravitation, Kepler’s laws, orbital and escape velocity.

identidades-trigonometricas.descricao: The fundamental identity, double angle and angle sum.

impulso-e-momento.descricao: Conservation of momentum and collisions — the principle that moves a rocket.

inequacoes.descricao: Inequalities, flipping the sign and the solution set on the line.

integrais-de-linha.descricao: Accumulating along a path, and when the path stops mattering.

integrais-improprias.descricao: Integrals with an infinite limit or an unbounded integrand, and when they converge.

integrais-multiplas.descricao: Summing over a region: iterated integration, volume and average value.

integral-definida.descricao: Signed area and the properties of the integral.

integral-indefinida.descricao: Antiderivatives and why the constant of integration shows up.

juros-compostos.descricao: Exponential growth applied to money over time.

lei-senos-cossenos.descricao: Solving triangles that have no right angle.

leis-de-newton.descricao: Inertia, F = ma and action and reaction, with free-body diagrams.

limites-laterais.descricao: Arriving from the left and from the right, and when the limit does not exist.

limites.descricao: Formal definition, properties and indeterminate forms.

matrizes-determinantes.descricao: Matrix operations, the determinant as area and Cramer’s rule.

metodos-numericos.descricao: Euler, Runge-Kutta and the order with which the error responds to the step.

mmc-mdc.descricao: Prime factorization, Euclid’s algorithm and where each one is used.

momento-angular.descricao: Why the skater speeds up when she pulls her arms in — and what that does on a satellite.

movimento-circular.descricao: Angular velocity, centripetal acceleration and the force that holds the curve.

movimento-harmonico.descricao: The oscillation of a spring described by sine and cosine.

nocao-intuitiva-de-limite.descricao: Getting close to a value without necessarily reaching it.

notacao-matematica.descricao: Reading what the symbols say and writing in symbols what you mean.

numeros-complexos.descricao: The Argand plane, polar form and multiplication as rotation.

numeros-decimais.descricao: Decimals as fractions with powers of ten in the denominator, and repeating decimals.

operacoes-fundamentais.descricao: Properties of addition and multiplication, and the order of operations.

polinomios.descricao: Degree, division, the remainder theorem and the hunt for roots.

ponto-e-reta.descricao: Distance between points, the equation of a line, parallel and perpendicular.

potenciacao-radiciacao.descricao: Properties of powers, negative exponents and roots as powers.

probabilidade.descricao: Sample space, independent events and conditional probability.

produto-escalar-vetorial.descricao: Projection, angle between vectors, work and torque as products.

produtos-notaveis.descricao: Square of a sum and difference of squares, with a geometric proof.

progressoes.descricao: General term, sum of terms and where each pattern shows up.

propulsao-de-foguetes.descricao: Thrust, specific impulse and the Tsiolkovsky equation.

razao-proporcao.descricao: Comparing quantities, cross-multiplication and inverse proportionality.

regra-da-cadeia.descricao: Differentiating composite functions and why the differentials appear to cancel.

regras-de-derivacao.descricao: Power, product and quotient, proved from the definition.

regressao-e-correlacao.descricao: The line that best passes through the points, and how much it explains.

semelhanca-e-pitagoras.descricao: Similarity ratio, the intercept theorem and the proof of Pythagoras.

seno-cosseno-tangente.descricao: How the three ratios relate and why the tangent has asymptotes.

series-de-taylor.descricao: Approximating a function with polynomials, and the error that remains.

sistemas-lineares.descricao: The substitution method, with the solution seen as where lines meet.

solidos-e-volumes.descricao: Prisms, cylinders, cones and spheres: volume, surface area and cubic scaling.

soma-de-riemann.descricao: Approximating area with rectangles and refining the partition to the limit.

taxa-de-variacao.descricao: Velocity and acceleration as derivatives of position.

tecnicas-de-integracao.descricao: Substitution, integration by parts and partial fractions.

teorema-fundamental.descricao: The bridge showing that differentiating and integrating are inverse operations.

termodinamica-e-gases.descricao: Ideal gases, the first law and the work an expansion performs.

trabalho-e-energia.descricao: Work as a dot product, kinetic and potential energy, and conservation.

trajetoria-balistica.descricao: Oblique launch: range, maximum height and time of flight.

transferencia-de-calor.descricao: Conduction, convection and radiation, and the re-entry of a spacecraft.

transformacoes-de-graficos.descricao: Shifting, stretching and reflecting — reading the graph of f(x) + k, f(x + k) and a·f(x) without redoing the table.

triangulo-retangulo.descricao: Sine, cosine and tangent as ratios of sides, and Pythagoras.

vetores-no-espaco.descricao: The x, y and z components, unit vectors and both products in three dimensions.

vetores-no-plano.descricao: Magnitude, direction and sense, the parallelogram rule and decomposition.

vizinhancas-e-infinito.descricao: Epsilon and delta, and how functions behave at infinity.
